result.Method of Attack: Dependency confusion attack by uploading malicious packages with the same internal Yandex npm package names to the public npm registry; Malicious code embedded in the preinstall script of package.json to exfiltrate sensitive information from victim machines via HTTP requests
result.Discoverer: 奇安信技术研究院星图实验室
result.Impacted Systems: npm ecosystem users, Yandex internal npm package users
result.Attack Vector: Uploading malicious packages with identical names to internal Yandex npm packages to public npm registry (dependency confusion)
result.Indicators of Compromise: Malicious packages uploaded to registry.npmjs.com; HTTP requests sent to 5 different remote URLs containing stolen sensitive information; 428 malicious packages exploiting Yandex internal npm package names uploaded within 2 days
